policy: The full Carnegie R1 registry is retained for coverage auditing. Active discovery is intentionally restricted to universities with an unmistakably strong national or global institutional brand. Core institutions are searched routinely. Direct-fit-only institutions have the required brand strength but a college-town/location trade-off, so only explicitly targeted HCI, XR, spatial-computing, or human-AI searches qualify. Field strength alone cannot rescue a less prominent institution.

reasons.Core: Unmistakably strong national/global university brand, research reputation, and an acceptable location for routine monitoring.
reasons.Direct-fit only: The university brand clears the bar, but the college-town/location trade-off requires an explicitly targeted research fit.
reasons.Excluded: The institutional brand or location does not clear the intentionally strict application threshold; field strength alone is insufficient.
